study type: Method development and application (Mediation analysis using cohort data)
cohort: The study participants were 470 women from the Etude des Determinants pre et postnatals du developpement de la sante de l'Enfant (EDEN) cohort.
finding: The developed HDMAX2 method demonstrated increased power and revealed a polygenic architecture for the mediation pathway between maternal smoking and birth outcomes, with placental DNA methylation accounting for 32.1% of the total effect on lower birth weight.
